ELECTRICITY METER HACKING

By: Nicky Troll | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We go undercover to expose Electricity Meter Hackers who charge a once of “service” fee to break the law and give clients free power.

Unique Selling Point:
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
- UNDERCOVER INVESTIGATION
- CONFRONT
- TOPICAL IN THIS ECONOMIC CLIMATE

Summary:
Times are tough and cash is tight. South Africans are looking for ways to cut back on living expenses and shady service providers are oh too willing to help – even if it means breaking the law.

With the state of Eskom as it is and electricity hikes inevitable - Electricity Meter Hackers are taking the gap.

For a fee, these guys will jippo your electricity supply and hook you up to pay a fraction of the cost if at all.

We go undercover to expose these crooks and catch them red handed.

Further information:
I’ve heard of guys that offer this service for months now, but have not been able to get anyone to give me a referral – I think because those that know don’t want to burn their contact.

In a desperate attempt to find a story that I can get going on, I decided to search on Gumtree for dodgy electricians and just make a few phone calls to see if I get any bites.

BUT THAT WASN’T EVEN NECESSARY!!
A Gumtree Ad listed as FREE POWER – has narrowed it down for me 
HERE IS THE SALES PITCH

" Our Mission: to erase or reduce your electricity bill(s). Whether you're using meter electricity, prepaid sub-meter or another source, We see to it that your electricity costs are eliminated completely or drastically reduced.

What we do is no child's play. It is dangerous. It is dangerous for us because if we get caught, make one misstep or one miscalculation - it's game over for us. You, the client get 100% protection from any bad consequences. For example: if the cops, Eskom or the municipality shows up while we're working on your specific Power issue; we're the ones who'll have some explaining to do. Your dignity, integrity and satisfaction is what drives us.

Yes, we do charge for what we do. There is no Free Lunch"


COSTS
The stings should cost about R2000.


THE RESEARCH
I reached out to 10 electricians on Gumtree – one read my message and didn’t bother to answer, four said NO, and the other 5 were willing.

Of the five, two could only do pre-paid meters. Of the remaining three the one with the great Gumtree ad wanted to overcharge because I’m white. So we are left with two dodgy electricians to expose.

** We can really make these guys into characters with the sales pitches and voice notes.

HOW WE DO IT
In this story we are the case study again, our investigation is the story – like in the SASSA story – we’ve heard the rumours – we wanted to test if it was possible and how hard it would be to find someone willing to jippo an electricity meter.

We share our process of getting a sample of 10, we use the voice notes and build our case. Then we do the undercover with the two guys.

We get the Electrical Contractors Association (ECA) to come in and do an inspection, confirm everything is legit. Then we call in the dodgy electricians and let them do their work. Immediately after they leave, we get the ECA to come in and give us feedback, and then undo the dodgy work. I might do those interviews myself – need to think about presenter logistics.

** THE MUNICIPALITY’S ELECTRICAL DEPARTMENT IS ON BOARD TO INSTALL NEW METERS.

Then we interview the municipality about how big an issue it is, we speak about the implications and the possible fines if you’re caught.

And then of course we have two classic busts 

** Maybe a municipal finance expert to give the bigger picture impact – already are municipalities are buckling under massive outstanding fees with billions owed to them – stealing electricity is not the solution.


INTERVIEWS / ELEMENTS
- STINGS – THE SET UP & THE UNDERCOVER
- ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS ASSOCIATION – WHY THIS IS AN ISSUE – CRIMINAL AND DANGEROUS.
- ETHEKWINI MUNICIPALITY – WHAT ARE THEY DOING ABOUT IT
- THE CONFRONTS

STRUCTURE: ELECTRICITY METER HACKERS

VO: Making ends meet is becoming a daily struggle, and more and more of us are trying to cut back on living expenses.

LINK: People are even getting creative about it, looking for shady service providers who’ll cheat the system to help them save money – even if it means breaking the law.

VO: Electricity is a big expense for most households. And with inevitable electricity hikes, switching off lights and reducing consumption may not cut it for some families.

But never fear, so-called Electricity Meter Hackers brazenly claim to have the solution. For a once-off fee, these guys will tamper with your electricity meter so that you only pay a fraction of the actual consumption cost - if, at all.

LINK: Everyone seems to know a guy, but no one wants to share their contact’s details…

VO: Up for the challenge, we set out to track down electricity meter hackers.

We randomly contacted 10 electricians advertising on a local website to see if we’d get a bite. Surprisingly, it was easier than we anticipated.

This “Free Power” ad blatantly promotes their meter hacking services. It was posted not by an electrician, but a middleman connecting dodgy electricians with dodgy clients.

UPSOUND “It is dangerous for us because if we get caught….it's game over for us….”

VO: A risk, they appear willing to take, for a price.

Initially the price was R700 for their service – but as it turns out – that price is not for everyone. You’re about to hear a conversation between the electrician and the middleman that posted the ad.

Electrician – For who is it?
Middleman – It’s a white person, a white person staying in Glenwood.
Electrician – No,no, no, it has to be expensive - five block.
Middleman – R5000?
Electrician – Yes. Those white people are always trouble makers.

VO: Not keen to be overcharged, we carried on looking… One electrician didn’t even reply to us, while four electricians said NO to slowing down meters ,

VO: Besides our Free Power man – 4 others , agreed – so that’s 50% of the sample willing to illegally slow down electricity meters.

Some shamelessly offer their services, as you can hear in this voice note from a man you’ll be seeing a lot of later.

SPARKY: that is very easy. So yah, I can dala that thing for you there.

VO: Let’s back up a moment – this is how it works with post-paid electricity customers – a municipal meter measures your consumption. As the disk rotates, the meter numbers tick over. The more power you draw, the faster it spins, the more you pay…. UNLESS, you can slow it down.

But that would require breaking the municipal seal and tampering with the meter – which is illegal.

MAX: People who are doing it, Do it at your own risk.

VO: Maxwell Mthembu is EThekwini Municipality’s Head of Electricity, he warns, it’s not only the dodgy electrician that could land in hot water.

MAX: Two people are wrong. // as much as we are looking for the criminal who did that, but also looking for that customer of ours who wants to cheat the system. no one comes and does that illegally without the consent of the customer.

LINK: Curious to know if it’s all talk or if these seemingly shady electricians will deliver, we’re going to set up two stings using an undercover operative and hidden cameras.

VO: With eThekwini Municipality’s permission to jippo two meters – it was all systems go.

This is Yash, he charges R1200 for his illegal service and showed up with a toolbox full of tricks .

At first, he tried magnets, but when that didn’t work on this meter – he didn’t give up – he carried on fiddling and fiddling.

YASH: Right now if I do this here, if it stops that means you’re getting free power so you’re not paying for it. But I need to slow it down.

VO: It took him more than an hour to find a solution.

YASH: It’s like a brake pad. IMG_6650 M2 on timeline
OP: What’s it like?
YASH: A brake pad. Ah! That’s better. It’s moving but it’s very ,very slowly.

VO: Initially, one rotation took just 4 seconds. After tampering, Yash slowed it down to 40 seconds for a single rotation. At that rate – you’d only be charged for 10% of your power usage.

In our second sting we met Sparky – he charges just R500 for his meter slowing service – he arrived on foot, armed with just a drill.

SPARKY: The idea is you want to stop that –
OP: Yes, because that makes the numbers go
SPARKY: So let’s take advantage of the sticker , you drill it there, you can see what I’m doing // you can put this back – you understand – so it’s not suspicious.

VO: Super pleased with himself, Sparky brought the meter to complete halt in less than 10 minutes.

We asked Wesley Hawkey, a registered Electrical Contractors Association electrician to inspect the meters.

He spotted Sparky’s trick immediately.

MASA: I'm disturbed by how easy this looks.
WES: I wouldn't suggest anybody trying this at home either, because end of the day, it's not your property.
MASA: Even if it's going to save me a quick buck.
WES: Nope, don’t touch this, it’s not yours.

VO: Only eThekwini Municipality employees and contractors are allowed to work on these meters.

MAX: It is our infrastructure You must know that if you're caught, there's a possibility of you'll go to jail for 15 years.

VO: When Hawkey inspected Yash’s handy work - the broken seals were a dead give-away.

WES: //If you remove this little piece of wire - you can see I'm really controlling the speed of it just by doing that. We take it out. There it goes.
MASA: Oh, wow. It’s going much quicker.
WES: The slower it goes. The less you're going to pay.
MASA: No matter what you’re using..
WES: the municipality actually getting robbed.

LINK: Bypassing your electricity meter, may even seem like a small deal to you in the grand scheme of state capture. But this is where corruption starts…. at home… People bending the rules for their own benefit.

VO: Low level corruption is not a lesser crime. Melusi Ncala is from Corruption Watch.

MELUSI: When people participate in acts of corruption. They often think of corruption as, a cultural norm in societ. Why not do it? Because that's how the system works. And and in simple terms, they simply aiding and abetting that system, they're not helping to actually curb the spread of corruption.

VO: About 4% of eThekwini municipality’s consumption is made up by non-technical losses – that amounts to a staggering R400 million, every year, lost to illegal activity.

MAX: How much can you do with that money? How many people can you connect? // But because now people are doing illegally connections in my network, they are costing me that amount of money a year.

VO: To combat this, eThekwini Municipality has a dedicated Revenue Protection Unit investigating suspicious customer consumption.

MAX: // If you are trying to rob the system you are just delaying your misery because one day we're going to catch you. You're not going to go back in history and we’re going to back charge you and you are going to pay every cent
MASA: // If a consumer thinks I'm cheating the system, they're wrong.
MAX: The answer is they are wrong// someone has helped you and told you they're not going to be caught. They wont be there when we catch you tomorrow.

VO: But we made sure to nab the dodgy electricians before they vanished on us.

Yash showed up expecting a referral job – but we were waiting for him with our camera crew.

MASA: You know what you’re doing is illegal.
YASH: I never did anything.
MASA: You do slowing down of meters, you do it.
YASH: I don’t do that.
MASA: // This conversation we're having where you're lying, is not going to work.
YASH: // I swear an oath. I’m a Christian – I never done slowing down meters//
MASA: I hear that you're a Christian. You're a Christian. That slows down meters.

VO: But Yash’ sudden convenient memory loss and hiding behind religion is not going to cut it.

MAX: Those of you understand the Ten Commandments, there's one that says, thou shalt not steal. It doesn't say, except if it is electricity.

VO: Yash was not willing to own up just yet.

YASH: Do you have proof that I’m slowing it?
MASA: You want that proof?

VO: Here you go! This is Carte Blanche – of course we have proof… We have it from 4 different angles.

MASA: Who's this here?
YASH JUST LOOKING….
MASA: Is this not you // You've never done it, hey?
YASH: I told her I can have a look at it.
MASA: Stop lying. We have you on video
YASH: KEEPING QUIET

VO 3: It finally clicked for Yash – he’s been caught out.

YASH: I won’t do that again
MASA: Do what?
YASH: Tamper with the meters

VO: An admission… finally.

Next it was Sparky’s turn - when we walked in, he was assessing the meter for slowing down.

MASA: What are you doing to it?
SPARKY: Uh, let me check if I can be able to sort of… She wants to upgrade. //
MASA: Upgrade what?
SPARKY: the set up like the DB Mm. ….

VO: Sparky went into great detail trying to cover his tracks [fast forward over the explaining]

MASA: Sparky let’s stop Because I know what you're doing.
SPARKY: Alright.
MASA: You're not upgrading. You're busy slowing down her meter, aren't you? //
You know, it's an illegal Sparky
SPARKY: I'm sorry you gave me such a fright. I. Can I just get some air?
MASA: Yeah. We’re outside there’s air…. let’s just chat // I’m trying to understand Why do you do it?
SPARKY: It’s the economy. TO be honest, I don't really have much of an answer now, you put me in a corner.

VO: While Sparky caught his breath, it became clear he was playing the desperate times call for desperate measures card - but that’s not going to fly.

MAX: The truth is Masa – there are so many people are suffering in South Africa, but it does not warrant that people must result in illegal activities. All in the name of being hungry. All in the name of being - aaah we are looking for jobs.

MASA: You helping people to steal?
SPARKY: People only do this out of The pressure, like this is become too much for us. We cannot afford to pay the rate. I don't. I don't do this.
MASA: So you tell them I don't do this, and then they force you – they’re Ah! Sparky we want this thing.
SPARKY: I've turned down a lot of people, actually
MASA This is serious. You could get into big trouble.
SPARKY: I feel the magnitude of the offence. It's just so wrong
MASA: I want to believe you. Hey.
SPARKY: I'm sorry. I didn't. If you thought I could get myself into such a mess.

VO: Sparky’s honesty and willingness to take accountability caught us off guard.


MAX: You guys must not feel bad when you catch these thieves. Actually, I want you to be happy with me. I'm not going to feel bad for them when I catch them, actually, I want to catch them. I want them to be caught. I want them to be jailed.

VO: While Electricity Meter Hacking may seem like a good idea to save some bucks right now, I’d think twice about it.

END

metadata.Unique Selling Point: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS - UNDERCOVER INVESTIGATION - CONFRONT - TOPICAL IN THIS ECONOMIC CLIMATE
metadata.Summary: Times are tough and cash is tight. South Africans are looking for ways to cut back on living expenses and shady service providers are oh too willing to help – even if it means breaking the law. With the state of Eskom as it is and electricity hikes inevitable - Electricity Meter Hackers are taking the gap. For a fee, these guys will jippo your electricity supply and hook you up to pay a fraction of the cost if at all. We go undercover to expose these crooks and catch them red handed.
metadata.Further information: I’ve heard of guys that offer this service for months now, but have not been able to get anyone to give me a referral – I think because those that know don’t want to burn their contact. In a desperate attempt to find a story that I can get going on, I decided to search on Gumtree for dodgy electricians and just make a few phone calls to see if I get any bites. BUT THAT WASN’T EVEN NECESSARY!! A Gumtree Ad listed as FREE POWER – has narrowed it down for me  HERE IS THE SALES PITCH " Our Mission: to erase or reduce your electricity bill(s). Whether you're using meter electricity, prepaid sub-meter or another source, We see to it that your electricity costs are eliminated completely or drastically reduced. What we do is no child's play. It is dangerous. It is dangerous for us because if we get caught, make one misstep or one miscalculation - it's game over for us. You, the client get 100% protection from any bad consequences. For example: if the cops, Eskom or the municipality shows up while we're working on your specific Power issue; we're the ones who'll have some explaining to do. Your dignity, integrity and satisfaction is what drives us. Yes, we do charge for what we do. There is no Free Lunch" COSTS The stings should cost about R2000. THE RESEARCH I reached out to 10 electricians on Gumtree – one read my message and didn’t bother to answer, four said NO, and the other 5 were willing. Of the five, two could only do pre-paid meters. Of the remaining three the one with the great Gumtree ad wanted to overcharge because I’m white. So we are left with two dodgy electricians to expose. ** We can really make these guys into characters with the sales pitches and voice notes. HOW WE DO IT In this story we are the case study again, our investigation is the story – like in the SASSA story – we’ve heard the rumours – we wanted to test if it was possible and how hard it would be to find someone willing to jippo an electricity meter. We share our process of getting a sample of 10, we use the voice notes and build our case. Then we do the undercover with the two guys. We get the Electrical Contractors Association (ECA) to come in and do an inspection, confirm everything is legit. Then we call in the dodgy electricians and let them do their work. Immediately after they leave, we get the ECA to come in and give us feedback, and then undo the dodgy work. I might do those interviews myself – need to think about presenter logistics. ** THE MUNICIPALITY’S ELECTRICAL DEPARTMENT IS ON BOARD TO INSTALL NEW METERS. Then we interview the municipality about how big an issue it is, we speak about the implications and the possible fines if you’re caught. And then of course we have two classic busts  ** Maybe a municipal finance expert to give the bigger picture impact – already are municipalities are buckling under massive outstanding fees with billions owed to them – stealing electricity is not the solution. INTERVIEWS / ELEMENTS - STINGS – THE SET UP & THE UNDERCOVER - ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS ASSOCIATION – WHY THIS IS AN ISSUE – CRIMINAL AND DANGEROUS. - ETHEKWINI MUNICIPALITY – WHAT ARE THEY DOING ABOUT IT - THE CONFRONTS
